purpose: Measured contact adaptation and radar-to-contact encoder chain; file-held-out exploration, not independent-bearing generalization

user_confirmed.keep: support/base fault outside current four classes
user_confirmed.bigNormal: another motor, healthy, same radar configuration

unconfirmed: rpm and load for each recording
geometry_status: outer and keep exported ROI around 0.884m disagrees with user geometry; original raw bin unavailable at protocol creation
split: For each class select one of its two entire paired recordings as training and the other as test; exhaust 16 four-class and 8 three-class combinations. Also fit all known recordings for separate external-only cases.
selection: No target selection, no target scaling, no random within-recording train/test split; fixed hyperparameters and final optimization step
teacher: retrained_fcn_fixed_external; 9 fixed MBHM train healthy references; external references are not operating-condition matched
contact_adaptation: Freeze original FCN; source-only weighted StandardScaler and L2 logistic four-class head, C=1; original classifier and independent spectral baseline reported
radar_encoder: Linear(input,128), LayerNorm, GELU, Dropout(0.1), Linear(128,64), GELU, Linear(64,128)
original_head_scope: Original ten-class probabilities collapse to four broad types; on the three-type task outer predictions remain out-of-scope errors, never renormalized away. Mean-probability and mean-hidden original-head baselines are distinct.
contrast: Bag means against contact bag means; all same-class bags are positives when more than one training bag per class. Does not establish time alignment.
external: keep and bigNormal never enter supervised training, scalers, model selection or threshold fitting; bigNormal evaluated only as healthy transfer cases; keep uncertainty scores descriptive, no calibrated rejection claim
statistics: File probability mean before macro-F1 and balanced accuracy; overlapping folds and optimization seeds are not independent physical experiments; no window bootstrap confidence intervals
LLM_bridge: Explicit four-type probabilities to ten-type probabilities by uniform within-type severity expansion, frozen final BearLLM linear3 and Qwen/LoRA. Report coarse type only; no severity evidence.
